rv.q: I fell hard for 'Fun Home' when I first saw it at the Public Theater, and had worried that this rare beauty might be damaged in its relocation.
Nonetheless, the takeaway is that this show (a finalist for the Pulitzer) could be staged on the back of a truck and still break your heart.
